headline: Brown University Professor Detects Mass AI Cheating on Midterm Exam
summary: At least 50 students in an advanced economics course are accused of using AI to commit fraud, marking a significant academic integrity scandal.
details: Professor Roberto Serrano of Brown University has uncovered what he calls 'overwhelming evidence' of mass AI fraud among his students. He claims at least 50 students cheated on a recent midterm exam in his advanced economics course, ECON 1170.

This incident is reportedly the largest academic integrity scandal to hit Brown University and the wider Ivy League. Serrano expressed disappointment with the university's initial response, stating it was a 'wake-up call' but not enough to address the magnitude of the issue.

Serrano, a distinguished economist and professor at Brown for 34 years, believes that academic integrity is under threat from AI. He advocates for a public debate on the extent of AI's misuse in higher education to preserve the value of teaching and learning.

The take-home midterm exam was designed to be challenging, with students asked to analyze statements under modified assumptions from those taught in class. The course, typically attracting fewer students, saw an enrollment of 86 this semester, possibly due to the new evaluation format.
